description: This file defines a Java class 'RegisterRequest' used as a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for registration requests, encapsulating user registration details such as name, email, password, and role with appropriate getters and setters.

classes.name: RegisterRequest
classes.description: A DTO class for handling registration request data, including user details such as name, email, password, and role.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the registering user.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the registering user.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Returns the email address of the registering user.

methods.name: setEmail
methods.description: Sets the email address of the registering user.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Returns the password provided during registration.

methods.name: getRole
methods.description: Returns the role specified during registration.
